### IC 37 Harvard-Oxford ###
```{r}
# This block computes the spatial overlap for VBM and JD of IC37 for the HOA 
## VBM ##
VBM <- read.table('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Flica_Output/ABIDE/iterations1500/FSL_format/150ica_secondfilter/VBM_R/Overlap_percentages.txt',
                  sep = "=",
                  header = FALSE,
                  strip.white = TRUE,
                  fill = TRUE)

labels <- readxl::read_xlsx('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/HOA/HarvardOxford_Atlas_NewIndex_YCG.xlsx')

# Deleting unneccesary labels 
which(colnames(labels) == "HOA Index")
labels <- labels[,-3]
which(colnames(labels) == "Hemisphere")
labels <- labels[,-4]
which(colnames(labels) == "Order")
labels <- labels[,-1]

# Changing label names
labels$Nomenclature <- dplyr::recode(labels$Nomenclature,
  "Juxtapositional Lobule Cortex (formerly Supplementary Motor Cortex)" = "Juxtapositional Lobule Cortex",
  "Superior Frontal Gyrus" = "SFG",
  "Middle Frontal Gyrus" = "MFG",
  "Inferior Frontal Gyrus, pars triangularis" = "IFG, pars triangularis",
  "Inferior Frontal Gyrus, pars opercularis" = "IFG, pars opercularis",
  "Superior Temporal Gyrus, anterior division" = "STG, anterior",
  "Superior Temporal Gyrus, posterior division" = "STG, posterior",
  "Middle Temporal Gyrus, anterior division" = "MTG, anterior",
  "Middle Temporal Gyrus, posterior division" = "MTG, posterior",
  "Middle Temporal Gyrus, temporooccipital part" = "MTG, temporo-occipital",
  "Inferior Temporal Gyrus, anterior division" = "ITG, anterior",
  "Inferior Temporal Gyrus, posterior division" = "ITG, posterior",
  "Inferior Temporal Gyrus, temporooccipital part" = "ITG, temporo-occipital",
  "Superior Parietal Lobule" = "SPL",
  "Supramarginal Gyrus, anterior division" = "SMG, anterior",
  "Supramarginal Gyrus, posterior division" = "SMG, posterior",
  "Lateral Occipital Cortex, superior division" = "LOC, superior",
  "Lateral Occipital Cortex, inferior division" = "LOC, inferior",
  "Cingulate Gyrus, anterior division" = "ACC",
  "Cingulate Gyrus, posterior division" = "PCC",
  "Precuneous Cortex" = "Precuneus",
  "Parahippocampal Gyrus, anterior division" = "PHG, anterior",
  "Parahippocampal Gyrus, posterior division" = "PHG, posterior",
  "Temporal Fusiform Cortex, anterior division" = "Fusiform, anterior",
  "Temporal Fusiform Cortex, posterior division" = "Fusiform, posterior",
  "Temporal Occipital Fusiform Cortex" = "Temporo-occipital Fusiform",
  "Occipital Fusiform Gyrus" = "Occipital Fusiform",
  "Frontal Orbital Cortex" = "Frontal Orbital",
  "Frontal Operculum Cortex" = "Frontal Operculum",
  "Central Opercular Cortex" = "Central Operculum",
  "Parietal Operculum Cortex" = "Parietal Operculum",
  "Intracalcarine Cortex" = "Intracalcarine",
  "Frontal Medial Cortex" = "Frontal Medial",
  "Subcallosal Cortex" = "Subcallosal",
  "Cuneal Cortex" = "Cuneus",
  "Supracalcarine Cortex" = "Supracalcarine",
  "Heschls Gyrus (includes H1 and H2)" = "Heschl's Gyrus",
  "Insular Cortex" = "Insula",
  "Paracingulate Gyrus" = "Paracingulate"
)

# Renaming and removing columns 
colnames(VBM) <- c("index", "IC", "direction", "modality", "hemisphere", "atlas", "overlap_pct") 

VBM_37 <- VBM[VBM$IC == "IC36", ]
VBM_37 <- merge(VBM_37, labels, by.x = "index", by.y = "New Index")
VBM_37 <- VBM_37[,-2]
VBM_37 <- VBM_37[VBM_37$overlap_pct != 0, ]
VBM_37 <- VBM_37 [order(VBM_37$overlap_pct, decreasing = TRUE),]

colnames(VBM_37) 
VBM_37 <- VBM_37[, c(7, 2, 3, 4, 6, 5,1)]
colnames(VBM_37) <-  c("StructName", "direction", "modality", "hemisphere", "overlap_pct", "atlas", "index")  
colnames(VBM_37)
```

```{r}
# Using patchwork package

subcort <- c("Thalamus", "Caudate", "Putamen", "Pallidum",
             "Hippocampus", "Amygdala", "Accumbens", "Brain-Stem")

set2_cols <- brewer.pal(4, "Set2") # picking the colors

small_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +   # minimal ggplot style (no grey background)
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 6.5),                # defining font for the plot
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 6),                   
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),                         # remove minor grid lines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),                         
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),  
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 6.5),          
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 7),            
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 6.5),          
    legend.key.size    = unit(3, "mm")                            # coloured squares in ledgend
  )

# Shortening the names 
shorten <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(x,
    "Juxtapositional Lobule Cortex" = "SMA",
    "Postcentral Gyrus"             = "PoCG",
    "Precentral Gyrus"              = "PreCG",
    "Occipital Fusiform"            = "Occipital FFG",
    "Fusiform, posterior"           = "FFG, posterior",
    "Temporo-occipital Fusiform"    = "Temporo-occipital FFG",
    "Angular Gyrus"                 = "AG",
    "Lingual Gyrus"                 = "LG",
    "Superior Frontal"              = "SFG",
    "Superior Frontal Sulcus"       = "SFS",
    "Middle Frontal"                = "MFG",
    "Middle Frontal Sulcus"         = "MFS",
    "Inferior Frontal Sulcus"       = "IFS",
    "Inferior Temporal"             = "ITG",
    "Middle Temporal"               = "MTG",
    "Lateral Superior Temporal"     = "STG, lateral",
    "Superior Temporal Sulcus"      = "STS",
    "Transverse Temporal Sulcus"    = "Transverse temporal S.",
    "Superior Parietal"             = "SPL",
    "Supramarginal"                 = "SMG",
    "Superior Occipital"            = "SOG",
    "Superior Occipital Sulcus"     = "SOS",
    "Inferior Occipital Gyrus and Sulcus" = "IOG and S.",
    "Anterior Cingulate"            = "ACC",
    "Marginal Cingulate Sulcus"     = "Marginal cing. S.",
    "Pericallosal Sulcus"           = "Pericallosal S.",
    "Central Sulcus"                = "CS",
    "Precentral"                    = "PreCG",
    "Postcentral"                   = "PoCG",
    "Paracentral"                   = "PCL",
    "Parahippocampal"               = "PHG",
    "Calcarine Sulcus"              = "Calcarine S.",
    "Collateral Sulcus"             = "Collateral S.",
    "Suborbital Sulcus"             = "Suborbital S.",
    "H-shaped Orbital Sulcus"       = "H-shaped orbital S.",
    "Orbital Gyrus"                 = "Orbital gyrus",
    "Inferior Circular Insula"      = "Inf. circular insula",
    "Superior Circular Insula"      = "Sup. circular insula",
    "Long Insular Gyrus"            = "Long insular gyrus",
    "Short Insular Gyrus"           = "Short insular gyrus"
  )
}

# Top 10 overlap regions per hemisphere and direction (pos/neg), stacked by modality (vertical bars)
make_bar_v <- function(df, hemi, dir, ttl, sub, fill_scale, n_top = 10) {
  d <- df[df$hemisphere == hemi & df$direction == dir, ]                        # keep only the rows of this hemisphere and direction
  d$StructName <- shorten(as.character(d$StructName))                           # shorten region names
  top <- d %>% group_by(StructName) %>% summarise(tot = sum(overlap_pct)) %>%   # summed overlap across modalities per region
    slice_max(tot, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE)                                # keep the n_top largest
  d <- d %>% filter(StructName %in% top$StructName) %>%
    mutate(StructName = factor(StructName, levels = top$StructName))            # order: largest on the left
  ggplot(d, aes(x = StructName, y = overlap_pct, fill = modality)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, show.legend = TRUE) +                                # stacked bars, one segment per modality
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +   # bars start at 0, about 4 ticks
    fill_scale + small_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),         # slanted region names
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line()) +                                # horizontal grid lines
    labs(title = ttl, subtitle = sub, x = NULL, y = "Overlap (%)")
}

# Cortical volumetric data only (subcortical regions removed)
vol_cort_all <- vol_data %>% filter(!StructName %in% subcort)

# One fill scale for all four modalities
all_fill <- scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(vbm = set2_cols[2], jd = set2_cols[1], ct = set2_cols[3], pa = set2_cols[4]),
  limits = c("vbm", "jd", "ct", "pa"),
  labels = c("VBM", "JD", "CT", "SA"),
  name = "Modality", drop = FALSE)

# Combine volumetric (cortical only) and surface data
all_data <- bind_rows(vol_cort_all, surf_data)

p1 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "L", "pos", "Left hemisphere",  "NAI > autism", all_fill)
p2 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "R", "pos", "Right hemisphere", "NAI > autism", all_fill)
p3 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "L", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", all_fill)
p4 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "R", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", all_fill)

p_all <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_all

ggsave('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/modality_overlap_combined_rotated.pdf',
       p_all, width = 11.5, height = 15, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
# Long -> wide: one row per region and hemisphere, one column per direction x modality
make_wide <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Modality   = recode(toupper(modality), "PA" = "SA"),                    # "pa" -> "SA" (surface area)
           key        = paste(direction, Modality, sep = "_"),                     # e.g. pos_VBM 
           hemisphere = ifelse(hemisphere %in% c("lh", "L"), "L", "R")) %>%
    group_by(StructName, hemisphere, key) %>%                                      # when multiple values together, group them
    summarise(overlap = round(sum(overlap_pct), 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = overlap) %>%                        
    arrange(desc(pmax(!!!syms(setdiff(names(.), c("StructName", "hemisphere"))), na.rm = TRUE)))
}

# Save one CSV per table
write.csv(make_wide(filter(vol37, atlas == "HOC")), '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/TableF1_IC37_cortical_vol.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
